data.title: Amnesty International announces Iran attacks on Gulf states may be war crimes | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: At least 28 people were killed and hundreds were injured after Iran launched unprovoked attacks on GCC countries, though information on said attacks was largely restricted by those states.
